verdict.rationale: Termius states that IPs, ports and passwords are all saved so you 'connect instantly' without re-entering them (termius-docs-1). Credentials in the Keychain can be reused across Hosts and Groups (termius-docs-3), and hosts and keys sync across devices via encrypted vaults (termius-docs-32, termius-docs-29). This covers the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single-tap/click connect gesture on a saved host, independent hands-on corroboration of credential-free reconnects.
